{"files": [{"content": "# Blackout

## Problem

People who stare at screens all day struggle to do thinking work (planning, brainstorming, clarifying ideas) without getting distracted. The tool they work with and the thing that distracts them is the same screen.

Most focus apps try to remind you to concentrate. Blackout takes a different approach: let people get the thinking done without looking at the screen at all.

## What it is

Blackout is a thinking tool, not a health or attention treatment. You state one goal, the screen goes completely black, and you think out loud — walking around, lying down, or sketching on paper. The AI listens continuously, tracks the line of thought against your goal, and mostly stays silent. When the session ends, the screen returns with one page: decisions, todos, a parking lot for off-topic ideas, unresolved questions, contradictions, unfinished points, and anything you asked it to look up or draft.

## How it differs from a voice assistant

A normal voice assistant is question-and-answer: you ask, it answers every time. Blackout manages attention:

- Silence is the main behaviour. Most turns get no reply at all, just a very quiet tick so you know you were heard.
- It tracks the line of thought against a stated goal. It notices unfinished points and contradictions and asks short follow-ups at natural pauses.
- When you drift off-topic, it stores the idea in a parking lot and pulls you back, instead of chatting along.
- Speaking is deliberately rationed: a minimum gap between spoken interventions, with pull-backs and direct answers exempt.
- It ends with one structured page: goal, decisions, todos, parking lot, open questions, contradictions, and unfinished points.

The black screen shows nothing to read. All AI replies are voice-only, so eyes stay off the screen.

## A short demo of the flow

1. On the start page you say or type a goal, for example “想清楚比赛 demo 的技术方案”, and press 开始.
2. The screen goes pure black (#000) with only a dim corner dot (paused / listening / AI speaking / reconnecting). A spoken line tells you the controls, because you are no longer looking.
3. You think out loud, hands-free. The AI stays quiet while the observer window (see below) quietly fills in the thought map.
4. You drift: “对了，中午吃火锅吧。” The AI parks it — “这个我先记下了，我们回到……” — and brings you back.
5. You ask: “帮我查一下……” It works in the background while you keep talking, then reports back in one spoken sentence. Nothing appears on the black screen.
6. You go quiet over an unfinished point; after a silence it nudges once: “「……」还没展开，还在想吗？”
7. You say “结束” (or press Esc). It says “好，我来整理”, and the result page appears with everything organised and a 复制为 Markdown button.

## How to stop, and other audible controls

You never need to look at the screen to stop. Say one of the end phrases (“结束”, “结束吧”, “结束了”, “停止”, “停”, “我说完了”, “说完了”, “就到这”, “就到这里”, “到这吧”, “不说了”, “先这样”) or press Esc. The app says “好，我来整理” to confirm it heard you, then builds the result page. If the browser leaves fullscreen with Esc, the session ends the same way, so you are never stuck on a black screen.

Every state and instruction is audible because the product is used without looking:

- On entering the black screen the app speaks: “黑屏开始。我在听，你直接说就行。按空格暂停，想结束就说结束，或者按 Esc。”
- In hands-free mode, Space or a short tap pauses and resumes, with rising/falling cues. Holding Space does not toggle repeatedly.
- The microphone stays on while the AI speaks, so you can talk over it: a real interruption cuts the AI off immediately. Muting during playback would lose whatever you said at that moment, which breaks the core promise that everything said is kept. Echo of the AI's own voice is separated from real speech on the server by comparing the recognised text with what was just spoken.
- A soft tick confirms you were heard, a two-note chime precedes background announcements, and rising/falling cues mark push-to-talk recording in fallback mode.
- If hands-free streaming is unavailable, the app says so and switches to push-to-talk: Space or tap starts and stops recording, recordings are uploaded as WAV, and announcements are polled and spoken.

## The observer window

Ticking “同时打开观察窗口（录视频用）” on the start page (or opening `/observer?session=<id>` on a second screen) shows a large-type, high-contrast, dark view designed to read clearly in a 1280×720 video without scrolling: the goal, a microphone state indicator （在听 / 暂停 / 用户在说 / AI 在说 / 未连接）, the live caption, the last AI decision and why, the thought map (main points marked 已展开/未展开； decisions, todos, questions, contradictions), the parking lot (briefly highlighted when something new is parked), background tasks, counters, and current spend. When the session finishes, it shows the result title and stops polling. The observer never appears in the black-screen flow.

## Architecture

- Backend: Python FastAPI in `app/`, thread-based; blocking model calls run in threads, and the WebSocket bridge uses asyncio with `asyncio.to_thread`.
  - `app/main.py`: app creation, middleware, error envelope, static files, router wiring.
  - `app/routes.py`: HTTP routes.
  - `app/security.py`: host and origin checks, access token, rate limit, security headers, body-size limits.
  - `app/realtime.py`: WebSocket bridge between the browser and the realtime speech API, including echo/interruption handling, coalescing of turns, delivery that never talks over the user, silence nudges, reconnects, and audio accounting.
  - `app/asr.py`: upstream realtime speech connection, handshake, and real-time pacing with a silence pump.
  - `app/conductor.py`: one turn of the conversation; decides what the AI does.
  - `app/state.py` / `app/store.py`: pure thinking-state functions and per-session persistence with locks.
  - `app/tasks.py`: background search and drafting on a thread pool.
  - `app/summary.py`: result page content, degrading to the stored lists if the model call fails.
  - `app/sketch.py`: paper-sketch understanding from a photo uploaded on the result page.
  - `app/prompts.py`: every prompt and JSON schema.
  - `app/phone.py`: LAN HTTPS launcher for phones (see below).
  - `app/static/`: `index.html`, `observer.html`, `app.css`, `observer.css`, and `js/*.js` — no framework, no external resources, no inline script or style; everything rendered from the server or the model uses `textContent`.
- Voice in (hands-free): `getUserMedia` + `AudioContext` + `AudioWorklet` captures 24 kHz mono PCM in 80 ms frames streamed over a WebSocket. While paused, zeroed frames are sent instead; while the AI speaks, the microphone keeps capturing (see above).
- Voice out: browser `speechSynthesis`, preferring a natural/online `zh-CN` voice, then any `zh-CN`, then any `zh`. There is no text-to-speech model in this project; speech output is the browser's.
- State is saved after every turn to one JSON file per session, written atomically, so a refresh, crash, or restart loses nothing. A task still marked `running` when a session is loaded after a restart becomes `failed`.

## How it uses Meta models

All model access goes through the preconfigured Muse client (`muse_client.py`, key read from `MODEL_API_KEY`); the key never reaches the browser or the logs, and speech and transcripts are never logged.

- `muse-voice-transcribe-1.0` — speech recognition. In hands-free mode it is used over the realtime WebSocket (`wss://api.meta.ai/v1/asr/realtime`) in endpointing mode with cumulative partials, so the app hears continuous speech, natural pauses, and interruptions. For push-to-talk and goal dictation, the same model transcribes uploaded WAV via `POST /asr/transcribe`.
- `muse-spark-1.3` — the conductor. Each turn sends the goal, the current thinking state, the last 12 history messages, and the new utterance, and returns strict structured additions (never a rewritten state, so nothing you said can be lost) plus one of: listen, follow up, pull back, continue, answer, summarise, or start a background task.
- `muse-spark-1.3` with the built-in `web_search` tool — background search for “帮我查一下……”. The first sentence of the result is a short conclusion that can be read aloud; details and sources are stored for the result page.
- `muse-spark-1.3` — background drafting for “帮我写一段……”. Drafts are never read aloud; they appear on the result page.
- `muse-spark-1.3` — sketch understanding. A photo of a paper sketch is sent with the goal and state; only what is visibly on the paper is recorded.
- `muse-spark-1.3` — result summarising. One final call merges duplicates and tightens wording for the result page; it may not add anything new, and the parking lot, contradictions, unfinished points, tasks, and sketches always come from the stored record verbatim.
- `muse-wonder-1.0` — the coding model that generated much of this repository (see “How this project was built”). It is not called by the running product.

## How to run on a computer

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

Create a `.env` file in the repo root (this file is not committed) and write your key:

```
MODEL_API_KEY=your-key-here
```

Then start the server from the repo root:

```bash
python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
```

Open `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. Type or speak a goal, enter the black screen, think out loud hands-free, say “结束” or press Esc to finish.

Run tests:

```bash
pytest
```

## How to run on a phone

Phones only allow the microphone over HTTPS, so use the phone launcher from the repo root:

```bash
python -m app.phone
```

It detects your LAN IP, generates (or reuses, while the IP still matches) a self-signed certificate under `data/tls/`, creates a random access token, and starts the server on `https://<your-lan-ip>:8443`. It prints the full URL — including the token — and a terminal QR code (if the optional `segno` package is installed; otherwise it prints the URL only). Scan it or type the URL on the phone. The phone will warn about the self-signed certificate once; accept it, and the token is stored in a secure cookie so the warning URL is not needed again. Keep the phone and computer on the same Wi-Fi network. The default computer mode above stays bound to 127.0.0.1 with no token; the access token, host/origin checks, and rate limit in `app/security.py` protect the phone mode, because this server can spend your money.

## Spend control

`budget.py` is the only hard spending limit and is enforced locally before any paid call: a JSONL ledger (`.muse_spend.jsonl`) records actual token, search, and audio costs, and calls are refused with HTTP 402 once the cap (`STOP_AT_USD`, $140) would be exceeded. Realtime audio is metered by the second of audio actually forwarded. `GET /api/status` reports `spent_usd` and `limit_usd`; the observer window shows the same figures. Budget exhaustion is announced by voice and ends hands-free sessions cleanly; summaries degrade to the stored lists instead of failing.

## Privacy

Sessions are stored locally on your own machine — by default in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Blackout` on Windows and `~/.blackout` elsewhere (override with `BLACKOUT_DATA_DIR`) — one JSON file per session, and `data/` is git-ignored. Nothing is sent anywhere except the Meta Model API: your goal, conversation text, and (for searches) the search instruction go to `muse-spark-1.3`, and your audio goes to `muse-voice-transcribe-1.0`. Speech and transcripts are never written to server logs, and the API key never reaches the browser or the logs. Web content returned by background search is treated as untrusted data: it is stored and spoken, never allowed to change state or trigger actions.

## Limitations, stated honestly

- Speech output quality depends entirely on the device and browser: it uses the browser's `speechSynthesis`, and speech output is not a Meta model. Without a Chinese voice installed, the AI may be hard to understand; Chrome or Edge with a `zh-CN` voice works best.
- Speech recognition is tuned for Mandarin Chinese and English; heavy dialect, noise, or crosstalk will produce mistakes, and echo detection — though text-based — is not perfect on speakers with strong reverberation.
- The phone flow has a one-time self-signed certificate warning, and requires the phone and computer to share a LAN.
- There is no usage data yet: Blackout has not been tested with anyone beyond its author, and no effectiveness claims are made. It is a thinking tool, not a treatment for attention problems, and it gives no health advice.
- A session is designed for up to about an hour of continuous hands-free audio; the bridge reconnects transparently across the speech API's 60-minute connection limit, but very long sessions are untested.

## How this project was built

Muse Spark, through the Meta Model API, generated all code in this repository, including the app, infrastructure, tests, and docs. Raw model output is in `muse_runs/`.

The author provided the idea and tried the product.

Claude Code (Anthropic's coding agent) drafted the prompts in `spec/` from the author's idea, ran the generation, reviewed and tested the output, and made the git commits.

Defects found in review and in the author's own use were written up in `spec/feedback_*.md`, and Muse generated every fix.

The staged v2 build-out, including this observer window, phone mode, and documentation stage, was specified in the `spec/stage_*.md` files alongside the earlier `spec/feedback_*.md` notes; each stage was generated by Muse from its stage file, reviewed, and tested the same way.

The first two commits contain earlier infrastructure files written by Claude Code. Muse regenerated them later from a behaviour description in `spec/feedback_05.md`, without being shown the earlier source.

import copy
import difflib
from typing import Any, Dict, List

END_PHRASES: frozenset = frozenset(["结束", "结束吧", "结束了", "停止", "停", "我说完了", "说完了", "就到这", "就到这里", "到这吧", "不说了", "先这样"])
CONFIRM_PHRASES: frozenset = frozenset(["对", "是", "好", "好的", "嗯", "可以", "是的"])
_PUNCT: str = "，。！？；：、．·…—–-.,!?;:\"'()[]{}《》〈〉「」『』【】（） \n\t\r"
LIST_LIMIT: int = 200


def clean_text(text: str) -> str:
    """Remove punctuation and spaces."""
    return "".join(ch for ch in str(text).strip() if ch not in _PUNCT)


def is_explicit_end(text: str) -> bool:
    """Exact end-phrase match only."""
    return clean_text(text) in END_PHRASES


def is_confirm(text: str) -> bool:
    """Exact confirmation match."""
    return clean_text(text) in CONFIRM_PHRASES


def is_echo(heard: str, spoken: str) -> bool:
    """True if `heard` is (mostly) the AI's own spoken text heard back.

    Both sides are stripped of punctuation and spaces. Heard text under
    2 characters is always treated as echo. Otherwise at least 60% of
    the characters of `heard` must be found in `spoken`, measured with
    difflib.SequenceMatcher matching blocks.
    """
    heard_clean: str = clean_text(heard)
    if len(heard_clean) < 2:
        return True
    spoken_clean: str = clean_text(spoken)
    if not spoken_clean:
        return False
    matcher: difflib.SequenceMatcher = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, heard_clean, spoken_clean)
    matched: int = sum(block.size for block in matcher.get_matching_blocks())
    return matched / len(heard_clean) >= 0.6


def new_state(goal: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Create a fresh state."""
    return {"goal": goal, "main_points": [], "parking_lot": [], "decisions": [], "todos": [], "open_questions": [], "contradictions": []}


def _append_unique(target: List[str], values: Any) -> None:
    if not isinstance(values, list):
        return
    for value in values:
        if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip() and value not in target:
            target.append(value)
        if len(target) >= LIST_LIMIT:
            break


def _apply_points(state: Dict[str, Any], additions: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    points: List[Dict[str, str]] = state["main_points"]
    raw: Any = additions.get("add_points", [])
    if isinstance(raw, list):
        existing: List[str] = [str(p.get("point", "")) for p in points if isinstance(p, dict)]
        for item in raw:
            if len(points) >= LIST_LIMIT:
                break
            if isinstance(item, dict):
                point: Any = item.get("point", "")
                status: Any = item.get("status", "未展开")
            else:
                point, status = item, "未展开"
            if not isinstance(point, str) or not point.strip():
                continue
            if point in existing:
                continue
            points.append({"point": point, "status": status if status in ("已展开", "未展开") else "未展开"})
            existing.append(point)
    expand: Any = additions.get("expand_points", [])
    if isinstance(expand, list):
        wanted: set = {x for x in expand if isinstance(x, str)}
        for point_obj in points:
            if isinstance(point_obj, dict) and point_obj.get("point") in wanted:
                point_obj["status"] = "已展开"


def apply_additions(state: Dict[str, Any], additions: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Return a new state with model additions applied."""
    result: Dict[str, Any] = copy.deepcopy(dict(state))
    for key, default in new_state(str(result.get("goal", ""))).items():
        result.setdefault(key, copy.deepcopy(default))
    _apply_points(result, additions)
    _append_unique(result["parking_lot"], additions.get("add_parking", additions.get("add_parking_lot", [])))
    _append_unique(result["decisions"], additions.get("add_decisions", []))
    _append_unique(result["todos"], additions.get("add_todos", []))
    _append_unique(result["open_questions"], additions.get("add_questions", additions.get("add_open_questions", [])))
    _append_unique(result["contradictions"], additions.get("add_contradictions", []))
    resolve: Any = additions.get("resolve_questions", [])
    if isinstance(resolve, list):
        wanted: set = {x for x in resolve if isinstance(x, str)}
        result["open_questions"] = [q for q in result["open_questions"] if q not in wanted]
    for key in ("main_points", "parking_lot", "decisions", "todos", "open_questions", "contradictions"):
        result[key] = result[key][:LIST_LIMIT]
    return result


def unexpanded_points(state: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[str]:
    """Names of unexpanded points."""
    out: List[str] = []
    points: Any = state.get("main_points", [])
    if isinstance(points, list):
        for item in points:
            if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("status") == "未展开" and isinstance(item.get("point"), str):
                out.append(item["point"])
    return out

import copy
import json
import logging
import os
import re
import threading
import time
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

from app.state import new_state

logger: logging.Logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
_ID_RE: re.Pattern = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{32}$")
_locks: Dict[str, threading.RLock] = {}
_locks_guard: threading.Lock = threading.Lock()
_cache: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
_outbox: Dict[str, List[Dict[str, str]]] = {}
_live: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {}
# Live microphone states: the user and the AI are never both "speaking".
LIVE_MIC_VALUES: frozenset = frozenset({"listening", "paused", "user_speaking", "ai_speaking", "offline"})
DEFAULT_LIVE: Dict[str, str] = {"mic": "offline", "partial": "", "last_user": "", "last_reply": "", "last_action": "", "last_reason": ""}
_REPLACE_DELAYS: List[float] = [0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.25]


def now_iso() -> str:
    """Current UTC timestamp."""
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def data_dir() -> Path:
    """Override, else %LOCALAPPDATA%\\Blackout on Windows, else ~/.blackout."""
    override: str = os.environ.get("BLACKOUT_DATA_DIR") or ""
    if override:
        return Path(override)
    if os.name == "nt":
        local: str = os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA") or ""
        if local:
            return Path(local) / "Blackout"
        return Path.home() / "Blackout"
    return Path.home() / ".blackout"


def sessions_dir() -> Path:
    """Directory containing session files."""
    return data_dir() / "sessions"


def is_valid_id(session_id: Any) -> bool:
    """Only uuid4 hex ids can become paths."""
    return isinstance(session_id, str) and bool(_ID_RE.match(session_id))


def session_path(session_id: str) -> Optional[Path]:
    """Path for a valid id, otherwise None."""
    if not is_valid_id(session_id):
        return None
    return sessions_dir() / f"{session_id}.json"


def get_lock(session_id: str) -> threading.RLock:
    """Per-session lock."""
    with _locks_guard:
        return _locks.setdefault(session_id, threading.RLock())


def _fix_loaded(record: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    changed: bool = False
    for task in record.get("tasks", []):
        if isinstance(task, dict) and task.get("status") == "running":
            task["status"] = "failed"
            task.setdefault("conclusion", "任务未完成")
            changed = True
    if changed:
        logger.info("running tasks marked failed on load")
    return record


def save_session(record: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Atomically save; retry replace, otherwise keep cache and do not raise."""
    session_id: str = str(record.get("id", ""))
    path: Optional[Path] = session_path(session_id)
    if path is None:
        raise ValueError("invalid session id")
    record["updated_at"] = now_iso()
    _cache[session_id] = record
    tmp: Path = path.parent / f".{session_id}.{uuid.uuid4().hex}.tmp"
    try:
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        tmp.write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("session write failed; record kept in cache")
        return record
    for attempt in range(6):
        try:
            os.replace(tmp, path)
            return record
        except PermissionError:
            if attempt < 5:
                time.sleep(_REPLACE_DELAYS[attempt])
        except OSError:
            if attempt < 5:
                time.sleep(_REPLACE_DELAYS[attempt])
    logger.error("session replace failed after retries; record kept in cache")
    try:
        tmp.unlink()
    except Exception:
        pass
    return record


def create_session(goal: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Create, persist, and return a session record."""
    session_id: str = uuid.uuid4().hex
    stamp: str = now_iso()
    record: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "id": session_id, "created_at": stamp, "updated_at": stamp, "status": "active",
        "state": new_state(goal), "history": [], "tasks": [], "sketches": [], "result": None,
        "stats": {"user_turns": 0, "ai_spoke": 0, "listened": 0, "pull_backs": 0, "nudges": 0},
    }
    save_session(record)
    _live[session_id] = dict(DEFAULT_LIVE)
    return record


def load_session(session_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Load from disk, converting stale running tasks."""
    path: Optional[Path] = session_path(session_id)
    if path is None or not path.is_file():
        return None
    try:
        record: Any = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("session load failed")
        return None
    if not isinstance(record, dict):
        return None
    record = _fix_loaded(record)
    _cache[session_id] = record
    return record


def get_session(session_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Return cached or disk session, or None."""
    if not is_valid_id(session_id):
        return None
    if session_id in _cache:
        return _cache[session_id]
    return load_session(session_id)


def get_session_copy(session_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Deep copy made under the session lock, safe to serialize."""
    with get_lock(session_id):
        record: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = get_session(session_id)
        return copy.deepcopy(record) if record is not None else None


def snapshot_session(session_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Alias used by snapshot/model/apply flows."""
    return get_session_copy(session_id)


def delete_session(session_id: str) -> bool:
    """Delete under the session lock so a concurrent save cannot revive it."""
    path: Optional[Path] = session_path(session_id)
    if path is None:
        return False
    with get_lock(session_id):
        existed: bool = session_id in _cache or path.is_file()
        _cache.pop(session_id, None)
        _outbox.pop(session_id, None)
        _live.pop(session_id, None)
        try:
            path.unlink()
        except FileNotFoundError:
            pass
        return existed


def list_sessions(limit: int = 50) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """Recent session summaries, newest first."""
    records: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    directory: Path = sessions_dir()
    if directory.is_dir():
        for path in directory.glob("*.json"):
            session_id: str = path.stem
            if not is_valid_id(session_id):
                continue
            record: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = _cache.get(session_id) or load_session(session_id)
            if record is not None:
                records.append(record)
    for record in _cache.values():
        if all(str(r.get("id")) != str(record.get("id")) for r in records):
            records.append(record)
    records.sort(key=lambda r: str(r.get("updated_at", "")), reverse=True)
    out: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    for record in records[:limit]:
        state: Any = record.get("state", {})
        out.append({"id": str(record.get("id", "")), "goal": str(state.get("goal", "")) if isinstance(state, dict) else "", "status": str(record.get("status", "active")), "created_at": str(record.get("created_at", "")), "updated_at": str(record.get("updated_at", ""))})
    return out

import copy
import json

import os
import time
from datetime import datetime

from muse_client import DEFAULT_MODEL, create_client
from app import state as state_mod
from app import store, tasks as tasks_mod

logger: logging.Logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
_last_spoke: Dict[str, float] = {}
_awaiting_end: set = set()
_NUDGE_POINT_LIMIT: int = 16
_NUDGE_CUT_CHARS: str = " ，。！？；：、,.!?;:·…—–- \t"


class TurnResult(dict):
    """Dict result with attribute access."""
    def __getattr__(self, name: str) -> Any:
        try:
            return self[name]
        except KeyError as exc:
            raise AttributeError(name) from exc


def clear_memory() -> None:
    """Clear in-memory conductor state."""
    _last_spoke.clear()
    _awaiting_end.clear()


def is_awaiting_end(session_id: str) -> bool:
    """Whether the session is waiting for an end confirmation."""
    return session_id in _awaiting_end


def note_spoken(session_id: str, text: str, kind: str, now: Any = None) -> None:
    """Record speech actually delivered outside a turn (announcement/nudge)."""
    if kind not in ("announcement", "nudge") or not str(text).strip():
        return
    ts: float = _now_ts(now)
    with store.get_lock(session_id):
        record: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = store.get_session(session_id)
        if record is None:
            raise KeyError(session_id)
        record.setdefault("history", []).append({"role": "assistant", "content": str(text), "at": store.now_iso()})
        stats: Dict[str, Any] = record.setdefault("stats", {"user_turns": 0, "ai_spoke": 0, "listened": 0, "pull_backs": 0, "nudges": 0})
        stats["ai_spoke"] = int(stats.get("ai_spoke", 0)) + 1
        if kind == "nudge":
            stats["nudges"] = int(stats.get("nudges", 0)) + 1
        _last_spoke[session_id] = ts
        store.save_session(record)


def _env_seconds(name: str, default: float) -> float:
    try:
        return float(os.environ.get(name, str(default)))
    except ValueError:
        return default


def is_budget_error(exc: Exception) -> bool:
    """Detect HTTP 402."""
    if getattr(exc, "status_code", None) == 402:
        return True
    return getattr(getattr(exc, "response", None), "status_code", None) == 402


def truncate_reply(reply: str) -> str:
    """Truncate only at a punctuation mark within 60 chars."""
    text: str = reply.strip()
    if len(text) <= 60:
        return text
    cut: str = text[:60]
    positions: List[int] = [cut.rfind(mark) for mark in "。！？；，、.!?;,"]
    pos: int = max(positions)
    return cut[: pos + 1] if pos >= 0 else cut


def _short_point(point: str) -> str:
    """At most 16 chars, cut at the last space/punctuation inside the limit if any."""
    text: str = str(point)
    if len(text) <= _NUDGE_POINT_LIMIT:
        return text
    cut: str = text[:_NUDGE_POINT_LIMIT]
    pos: int = max(cut.rfind(mark) for mark in _NUDGE_CUT_CHARS)
    if pos >= 1:
        trimmed: str = cut[:pos].rstrip(_NUDGE_CUT_CHARS)
        if trimmed:
            return trimmed
    return cut


def _now_ts(now: Any) -> float:
    if now is None:
        return time.time()
    if isinstance(now, datetime):
        return now.timestamp()
    return float(now)


def _call_model_once(record: Dict[str, Any], text: str, seconds_since: Optional[float]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    state: Dict[str, Any] = record.get("state", {})
    history: List[Dict[str, str]] = [{"role": str(h.get("role", "user")), "content": str(h.get("content", ""))} for h in record.get("history", [])[-12:] if isinstance(h, dict)]
    running: List[str] = [str(t.get("instruction", "")) for t in record.get("tasks", []) if isinstance(t, dict) and t.get("status") == "running"]
    content: str = build_turn_user_content(str(state.get("goal", "")), state, history, text, running, seconds_since)
    client: Any = create_client()
    resp: Any = client.responses.create(
        model=DEFAULT_MODEL,
        input=[{"role": "system", "content": TURN_SYSTEM_PROMPT}, {"role": "user", "content": content}],
        max_output_tokens=4000, reasoning={"effort": "low"},
        text={"format": {"type": "json_schema", "name": "blackout_turn", "schema": TURN_SCHEMA, "strict": True}},
    )
    status: Any = getattr(resp, "status", None)
    if isinstance(status, str) and status != "completed":
        raise RuntimeError("incomplete response")
    raw: Any = getattr(resp, "output_text", "")
    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.strip():
        raise RuntimeError("empty response")
    parsed: Any = json.loads(raw)
    if not isinstance(parsed, dict) or "action" not in parsed:
        raise RuntimeError("bad turn")
    return parsed


def _call_model_with_retry(record: Dict[str, Any], text: str, seconds_since: Optional[float]) -> Tuple[Optional[Dict[str, Any]], bool]:
    for _ in range(2):
        try:
            return _call_model_once(record, text, seconds_since), False
        except Exception as exc:
            if is_budget_error(exc):
                return None, True
            logger.exception("conductor model attempt failed")
    return None, False


def _save_turn(record: Dict[str, Any], text: str, reply: str, action: str) -> None:
    record.setdefault("history", []).append({"role": "user", "content": text, "at": store.now_iso()})
    if reply:
        record["history"].append({"role": "assistant", "content": reply, "at": store.now_iso()})
    stats: Dict[str, Any] = record.setdefault("stats", {"user_turns": 0, "ai_spoke": 0, "listened": 0, "pull_backs": 0, "nudges": 0})
    stats["user_turns"] = int(stats.get("user_turns", 0)) + 1
    if action == "listen":
        stats["listened"] = int(stats.get("listened", 0)) + 1
    if reply:
        stats["ai_spoke"] = int(stats.get("ai_spoke", 0)) + 1
    if action == "pull_back":
        stats["pull_backs"] = int(stats.get("pull_backs", 0)) + 1
    store.save_session(record)


def _result(text: str, action: str, reply: str, reason: str = "", end: bool = False, task_started: bool = False, budget: bool = False) -> TurnResult:
    return TurnResult({"transcript": text, "action": action, "reply": reply, "reason": reason, "end": end, "task_started": task_started, "budget_exhausted": budget})


def _end_locked(session_id: str, record: Dict[str, Any], text: str) -> TurnResult:
    _awaiting_end.discard(session_id)
    _save_turn(record, text, "", "summarize")
    store.update_live(session_id, last_user=text, last_reply="好，我来整理", last_action="summarize", last_reason="", mic="ai_speaking")
    return _result(text, "summarize", "好，我来整理", "", True)


def _pre_model(session_id: str, text: str) -> Tuple[Optional[Dict[str, Any]], Optional[TurnResult]]:
    """Under lock: finished/end/confirm handling; else a deep snapshot."""
    with store.get_lock(session_id):
        record: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = store.get_session(session_id)
        if record is None:
            raise KeyError(session_id)
        if record.get("status") == "finished":
            return None, _result(text, "summarize", "", "", True)
        if state_mod.is_explicit_end(text):
            return None, _end_locked(session_id, record, text)
        if session_id in _awaiting_end:
            if state_mod.is_confirm(text):
                return None, _end_locked(session_id, record, text)
            _awaiting_end.discard(session_id)
        return copy.deepcopy(record), None


def _resolve_reply(parsed: Dict[str, Any], seconds_since: Optional[float]) -> Tuple[str, str, str, bool]:
    action: str = str(parsed.get("action", "listen"))
    if action not in ("listen", "follow_up", "pull_back", "continue", "answer", "summarize"):
        action = "listen"
    reply: str = truncate_reply(str(parsed.get("reply", ""))) if isinstance(parsed.get("reply", ""), str) else ""
    reason: str = str(parsed.get("reason", ""))[:20] if isinstance(parsed.get("reason", ""), str) else ""
    user_asked: bool = bool(parsed.get("user_asked_ai", False))
    gap: float = _env_seconds("BLACKOUT_MIN_SPEAK_GAP", 20.0)
    if action in ("follow_up", "continue") and not user_asked and seconds_since is not None and seconds_since < gap:
        action = "listen"
    return action, reply, reason, user_asked


def _task_request(parsed: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[str, str]:
    task_obj: Any = parsed.get("task", {})
    if isinstance(task_obj, dict) and task_obj.get("kind") in ("search", "draft"):
        instruction: Any = task_obj.get("instruction")
        if isinstance(instruction, str) and instruction.strip():
            return str(task_obj["kind"]), instruction.strip()
    return "none", ""


def _apply_parsed(session_id: str, text: str, parsed: Dict[str, Any], ts: float, seconds_since: Optional[float]) -> TurnResult:
    action, reply, reason, _asked = _resolve_reply(parsed, seconds_since)
    kind, instruction = _task_request(parsed)
    with store.get_lock(session_id):
        record: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = store.get_session(session_id)
        if record is None:
            raise KeyError(session_id)
        if record.get("status") == "finished":
            return _result(text, "summarize", "", "", True)
        record["state"] = state_mod.apply_additions(record.get("state", {}), parsed)
        task_started: bool = False
        if kind != "none":
            tasks_mod.start_task(session_id, kind, instruction)
            record = store.get_session(session_id) or record
            task_started = True
        if action == "summarize":
            reply = "要结束吗？说结束就行。"
            _awaiting_end.add(session_id)
        if action == "listen":
            reply = ""
        if task_started and not reply:
            reply = "好，我去弄，你继续说。"
            if action == "listen":
                action = "answer"
        if reply:
            _last_spoke[session_id] = ts
        _save_turn(record, text, reply, action)
        store.update_live(session_id, last_user=text, last_reply=reply, last_action=action, last_reason=reason, mic="ai_speaking" if reply else "listening")
        return _result(text, action, reply, reason, False, task_started)


def _apply_listen(session_id: str, text: str, budget: bool) -> TurnResult:
    with store.get_lock(session_id):
        record: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = store.get_session(session_id)
        if record is None:
            raise KeyError(session_id)
        if record.get("status") == "finished":
            return _result(text, "summarize", "", "", True)
        _save_turn(record, text, "", "listen")
        return _result(text, "listen", "", "", False, False, budget)


def process_speech(session_id: str, text: str, now: Any = None) -> TurnResult:
    """Snapshot, call model unlocked, then re-lock and apply."""
    ts: float = _now_ts(now)
    clean: str = text.strip()
    snapshot, early = _pre_model(session_id, clean)
    if early is not None:
        return early
    assert snapshot is not None
    last: Optional[float] = _last_spoke.get(session_id)
    seconds_since: Optional[float] = max(0.0, ts - last) if last is not None else None
    parsed, budget_failed = _call_model_with_retry(snapshot, clean, seconds_since)
    if budget_failed:
        return _apply_listen(session_id, clean, True)
    if parsed is None:
        parsed = {"action": "listen", "reply": "", "reason": "", "user_asked_ai": False, "task": {"kind": "none", "instruction": ""}}
    return _apply_parsed(session_id, clean, parsed, ts, seconds_since)


def nudge_text(session: Any, seconds_since_speech: float, nudge_count: int) -> Optional[str]:
    """Deterministic silence nudge."""
    if not isinstance(session, dict):
        return None
    if session.get("paused"):
        return None
    tasks_list: Any = session.get("tasks", [])
    if isinstance(tasks_list, list) and any(isinstance(t, dict) and t.get("status") == "running" for t in tasks_list):
        return None
    first: float = _env_seconds("BLACKOUT_NUDGE_SECONDS", 60.0)
    if nudge_count == 0 and seconds_since_speech < first:
        return None
    if nudge_count == 1 and seconds_since_speech < first + 120.0:
        return None
    if nudge_count not in (0, 1):
        return None
    if nudge_count == 1:
        # The second nudge never repeats the point from the first.
        return "还在吗？卡住的话，先说一个最小的问题。"
    state: Any = session.get("state", session)
    points: List[str] = state_mod.unexpanded_points(state) if isinstance(state, dict) else []
    if points:
        return f"「{_short_point(points[0])}」还没展开，还在想吗？"
    return "还在吗？卡住的话，先说一个最小的问题。"

import json
import logging
import os
import time
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Set, Tuple
from urllib.parse import urlparse

from fastapi import WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect

import budget
from muse_client import load_api_key
from app import conductor, store
from app.asr import AsrStream
from app.state import clean_text, is_confirm, is_echo, is_explicit_end

logger: logging.Logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
DEFAULT_ASR_URL: str = "wss://api.meta.ai/v1/asr/realtime"
BYTES_PER_SECOND: int = 48000
MAX_FRAME_BYTES: int = 64 * 1024
TTS_TIMEOUT: float = 20.0
TTS_STUCK_SECONDS: float = 30.0
_bridges: Dict[str, "Bridge"] = {}


def _env_float(name: str, default: float) -> float:
    try:
        return float(os.environ.get(name, str(default)))
    except ValueError:
        return default


def _tts_timeout() -> float:
    if "BLACKOUT_TTS_TIMEOUT" in os.environ or "BLACKOUT_TTS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS" in os.environ:
        return _env_float("BLACKOUT_TTS_TIMEOUT", _env_float("BLACKOUT_TTS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", TTS_TIMEOUT))
    return float(TTS_TIMEOUT)


def _upstream_url() -> str:
    return os.environ.get("BLACKOUT_ASR_URL", DEFAULT_ASR_URL)


def _key_allowed(url: str) -> bool:
    if url == DEFAULT_ASR_URL:
        return True
    host: str = (urlparse(url).hostname or "").lower()
    return host in ("127.0.0.1", "localhost")


def _backoff(attempt: int) -> float:
    if os.environ.get("BLACKOUT_RECONNECT_FAST"):
        return 0.05
    return float(2 ** max(0, attempt - 1))


class Bridge:
    """One browser/upstream pair for one session. All state lives on the loop."""

    def __init__(self, websocket: WebSocket, session_id: str) -> None:
        self.ws: WebSocket = websocket
        self.session_id: str = session_id
        self.stream: Optional[AsrStream] = None
        self.upstream: Optional[AsrStream] = None
        self.connected_at: float = 0.0
        self.forwarded_bytes: int = 0
        self._base_bytes: int = 0
        self.recorded_bytes: int = 0
        self.user_speaking: bool = False
        self.speaking_since: float = 0.0
        self.speaking_turns: Set[Any] = set()
        self.turn_started_playback: Dict[Any, bool] = {}
        # Suspect (possible echo) turns, keyed by turnId (which may be 0).
        # Value: {"confirmed": bool, "stop_sent": bool}. A suspect turn does
        # not set user_speaking / increment the counter until confirmed.
        self.suspect_turns: Dict[Any, Dict[str, bool]] = {}
        self.latest_turn_id: Any = None
        self.last_speech_end: float = time.monotonic()
        self.paused: bool = False
        self.pause_started: Optional[float] = None
        self.tts_playing: bool = False
        self.tts_started_at: float = 0.0
        self.tts_event: asyncio.Event = asyncio.Event()
        self.tts_event.set()
        self.last_spoken: str = ""
        self.tts_finished_at: float = 0.0
        self.speech_start_counter: int = 0
        self.queue: asyncio.Queue = asyncio.Queue()
        self.say_queue: asyncio.Queue = asyncio.Queue()
        self.tasks: List[asyncio.Task] = []
        self.ended: bool = False
        self.end_sent: bool = False
        self.fallback_sent: bool = False
        self.replaced: bool = False
        self.nudge_count: int = 0
        self.oversize_frames: int = 0
        self.browser_open: bool = True
        self._send_lock: asyncio.Lock = asyncio.Lock()

    async def _live(self, **values: str) -> None:
        await asyncio.to_thread(store.update_live, self.session_id, **values)

    async def _send(self, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        if self.replaced or not self.browser_open:
            return False
        try:
            async with self._send_lock:
                await self.ws.send_json(payload)
            return True
        except Exception:
            self.browser_open = False
            return False

    async def _close_browser(self) -> None:
        self.browser_open = False
        try:
            await self.ws.close(code=1000)
        except Exception:
            pass

    async def _send_end(self, reason: str) -> None:
        if self.end_sent:
            return
        self.end_sent = True
        self.ended = True
        await self._send({"type": "end", "reason": reason})
        await self._close_browser()

    async def _send_fallback(self, message: str = "自动听写断了。现在按空格开始说话，说完再按一次。") -> None:
        if self.fallback_sent or self.end_sent:
            return
        self.fallback_sent = True
        self.ended = True
        await self._send({"type": "fallback", "message": message})
        await self._close_browser()

    async def force_close(self, code: int = 4000) -> None:
        self.replaced = True
        self.browser_open = False
        try:
            await self.ws.close(code=code)
        except Exception:
            pass
        for task in list(self.tasks):
            task.cancel()

    def _sync_bytes(self) -> None:
        if self.stream is not None:
            self.forwarded_bytes = self._base_bytes + self.stream.bytes_sent

    def _fold_stream(self) -> None:
        self._sync_bytes()
        self._base_bytes = self.forwarded_bytes
        self.stream = None
        self.upstream = None

    def _clear_stuck_tts(self) -> None:
        if self.tts_playing and self.tts_started_at and time.monotonic() - self.tts_started_at > TTS_STUCK_SECONDS:
            self.tts_playing = False
            self.tts_finished_at = time.monotonic()
            self.tts_event.set()

    def _clear_stuck_speaking(self) -> None:
        if self.user_speaking and self.speaking_since and time.monotonic() - self.speaking_since > 30:
            self.user_speaking = False
            self.speaking_turns.clear()

    def _is_suspect_start(self, now: float) -> bool:
        if self.tts_playing:
            return True
        return bool(self.tts_finished_at) and (now - self.tts_finished_at) <= 1.0

    async def _confirm_suspect(self, turn_id: Any, send_stop: bool) -> bool:
        """Confirm a suspect turn as real user speech. Returns True if newly confirmed."""
        info: Optional[Dict[str, bool]] = self.suspect_turns.get(turn_id)
        if info is None or info.get("confirmed"):
            return False
        info["confirmed"] = True
        self.speaking_turns.add(turn_id)
        self.user_speaking = True
        self.speaking_since = time.monotonic()
        self.speech_start_counter += 1
        self.nudge_count = 0
        if send_stop and self.tts_playing and not info.get("stop_sent"):
            info["stop_sent"] = True
            await self._send({"type": "stop_speech"})
        return True

    async def run(self) -> None:
        old: Optional[Bridge] = _bridges.get(self.session_id)
        _bridges[self.session_id] = self
        if old is not None and old is not self:
            await old.force_close(4000)
        try:
            await self.ws.accept()
        except Exception:
            return
        try:
            record: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = await asyncio.to_thread(store.get_session, self.session_id)
            if record is None:
                await self.ws.close(code=1008)
                return
            if record.get("status") == "finished":
                await self._send_end("phrase")
                return
            can: bool = await asyncio.to_thread(budget.can_spend)
            if not can:
                await self._send_end("budget")
                return
            if not await self._connect_upstream():
                if not self.fallback_sent:
                    await self._send_fallback()
                return
            await self._send({"type": "ready"})
            await self._live(mic="listening")
            self.tasks = [
                asyncio.create_task(self._browser_loop()),
                asyncio.create_task(self._worker_loop()),
                asyncio.create_task(self._delivery_loop()),
                asyncio.create_task(self._announcement_loop()),
                asyncio.create_task(self._nudge_loop()),
                asyncio.create_task(self._record_loop()),
                asyncio.create_task(self._upstream_supervisor()),
            ]
            done, pending = await asyncio.wait(self.tasks, return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED)
            for task in pending:
                task.cancel()
        except WebSocketDisconnect:
            pass
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("realtime bridge failed")
        finally:
            await self._cleanup()

    async def _connect_upstream(self) -> bool:
        url: str = _upstream_url()
        if not _key_allowed(url):
            logger.error("refusing to send key to untrusted ASR host")
            return False
        try:
            key: str = load_api_key()
        except Exception:
            return False
        stream: AsrStream = AsrStream(url, key)
        if not await stream.connect():
            return False
        self._fold_stream()
        self.stream = stream
        self.upstream = stream
        self.connected_at = time.monotonic()
        return True

    async def _upstream_supervisor(self) -> None:
        attempts: int = 0
        while not self.ended and self.browser_open and not self.replaced:
            if self.stream is None:
                await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
                continue
            code: Optional[int] = await self._upstream_loop(self.stream)
            uptime: float = time.monotonic() - self.connected_at if self.connected_at else 0.0
            self._fold_stream()
            if self.ended or self.replaced or not self.browser_open:
                return
            if code == 1008:
                await self._send_fallback()
                return
            if uptime >= 30:
                attempts = 0
            while not self.ended and self.browser_open and not self.replaced:
                attempts += 1
                if attempts > 3:
                    await self._send_fallback()
                    return
                await self._send({"type": "reconnecting"})

    async def _record_loop(self) -> None:
        interval: float = _env_float("BLACKOUT_AUDIO_RECORD_INTERVAL", 30.0)

            await asyncio.sleep(min(30.0, max(0.05, interval)))

                await self._send_end("budget")
                return

    async def _cleanup(self) -> None:
        current: Optional[Bridge] = _bridges.get(self.session_id)
        is_current: bool = current is self

            task.cancel()

        try:

        except Exception:
            logger.exception("audio accounting failed")
        if is_current:
            _bridges.pop(self.session_id, None)
            try:
                await asyncio.to_thread(store.update_live, self.session_id, mic="offline", partial="")
            except Exception:
                pass


async def handle_websocket(websocket: WebSocket, session_id: str) -> None:
    bridge: Bridge = Bridge(websocket, session_id)
    await bridge.run()

def tls_dir() -> Path:
    """Certificate directory: data/tls under the working directory."""

def get_lan_ip() -> str:
    """Detect the LAN IP with a UDP socket trick that sends no packets.

    A UDP `connect` only records the peer address locally; nothing is
    transmitted. Raises RuntimeError with a clear message when there is
    no usable network.

        sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
        sock.connect(("8.8.8.8", 80))

    except Exception as exc:
        raise RuntimeError("无法检测到局域网 IP：这台设备似乎没有可用的网络连接。请连上 Wi-Fi 或局域网后再试。") from exc

            except Exception:

        .issuer_name(name)

        serialization.PrivateFormat.TraditionalOpenSSL,
        serialization.NoEncryption(),
    )
    return cert_pem, key_pem


def _restrict_permissions(path: Path) -> None:
    """Best-effort 0600 on the private key, where the platform supports it."""
    try:
        os.chmod(path, 0o600)
    except Exception:
        pass


def ensure_certificate(ip: str, directory: Optional[Path] = None) -> Tuple[Path, Path]:
    """Reuse a valid certificate for `ip`, otherwise regenerate it."""
    folder: Path = Path(directory) if directory is not None else tls_dir()
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cert_path: Path = folder / CERT_FILE_NAME
    key_path: Path = folder / KEY_FILE_NAME

    cert_pem, key_pem = _make_certificate(ip)

    _restrict_permissions(key_path)

    """Print a terminal QR code when segno is available; otherwise False."""
    try:

    except Exception:
        return False
    try:

        qr.terminal()
        return True
    except Exception:
        return False


def main(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> None:
    """Detect the LAN IP, prepare TLS + token, print the URL, and serve."""
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
    try:
        ip: str = get_lan_ip()

    hosts: List[str] = [item.strip() for item in allowed.replace(";", ",").split(",") if item.strip()]
    if ip not in hosts:
        hosts.append(ip)

    url: str = build_url(ip, token)
    # The token appears only here (the start-up URL and QR code), never in logs.
    print("Blackout 手机模式已准备好。")
    print("请在手机浏览器打开下面这个地址（手机和电脑要连同一个 Wi-Fi）：")

    import uvicorn

    uvicorn.run("app.main:app", host="0.0.0.0", port=PORT, ssl_certfile=str(cert_path), ssl_keyfile=str(key_path))

    main()

window.BlackoutObserver = (function () {
  const MIC_LABELS = {
    listening: "在听",
    paused: "暂停",
    user_speaking: "用户在说",
    ai_speaking: "AI 在说",
    offline: "未连接"
  };
  const ACTION_LABELS = {
    listen: "听着不打断",
    follow_up: "追问",
    pull_back: "拉回主线",
    continue: "推进",
    answer: "回答",
    summarize: "确认结束"
  };
  const TASK_STATUS = {
    running: "进行中",
    done: "完成",
    failed: "失败"
  };
  let sessionId = "";
  let timer = 0;
  let lastParkingJson = "";
  let lastTaskJson = "";
  let parkingSeen = false;
  function el(id) {
    return document.getElementById(id);
  }
  function sessionParam() {
    try {
      return new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("session") || "";
    } catch (e) {
      return "";
    }
  }
  function showMessage(text) {
    const node = el("obsMessage");
    node.textContent = String(text || "");
    node.hidden = !text;
  }
  function fillList(id, emptyId, items, decorate) {
    const list = el(id);
    list.replaceChildren();
    (items || []).forEach(function (item) {
      const li = document.createElement("li");
      if (decorate) {
        decorate(li, item);
      } else {
        li.textContent = String(item || "");
      }
      list.appendChild(li);
    });
    const empty = el(emptyId);
    if (empty) {
      empty.hidden = (items || []).length > 0;
    }
  }
  function renderPoints(points) {
    fillList("obsPoints", "obsPointsEmpty", points || [], function (li, point) {
      const text = document.createElement("span");
      text.textContent = String((point && point.point) || "");
      li.appendChild(text);
      const badge = document.createElement("span");
      const done = Boolean(point && point.status === "已展开");
      badge.className = "point-status " + (done ? "status-done" : "status-open");
      badge.textContent = done ? "已展开" : "未展开";
      li.appendChild(badge);
    });
  }
  function renderTasks(tasks) {
    fillList("obsTasks", "obsTasksEmpty", tasks || [], function (li, task) {
      const label = document.createElement("span");
      label.textContent = String((task && task.instruction) || (task && task.conclusion) || "");
      li.appendChild(label);
      const status = document.createElement("span");
      status.className = "task-status";
      status.textContent = "（" + String(TASK_STATUS[(task && task.status)] || "进行中") + "）";
      li.appendChild(status);
    });
    el("obsTasksEmpty").hidden = (tasks || []).length > 0;
  }
  function renderMic(mic) {
    const node = el("obsMic");
    const key = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(MIC_LABELS, mic) ? mic : "offline";
    node.textContent = MIC_LABELS[key];
    node.className = "mic mic-" + key;
  }
  function renderSession(record, live) {
    const state = (record && record.state) || {};
    el("obsGoal").textContent = String(state.goal || "（没有目标）");
    renderMic(String((live && live.mic) || "offline"));
    const partial = String((live && live.partial) || "");
    const lastUser = String((live && live.last_user) || "");
    el("obsCaption").textContent = partial || lastUser || "……";
    const action = String((live && live.last_action) || "listen");
    el("obsAction").textContent = ACTION_LABELS[action] || "听着不打断";
    el("obsReason").textContent = String((live && live.last_reason) || "");
    el("obsReply").textContent = String((live && live.last_reply) || "");
    renderPoints(state.main_points || []);
    fillList("obsDecisions", "", state.decisions || []);
    fillList("obsTodos", "", state.todos || []);
    fillList("obsQuestions", "", state.open_questions || []);
    fillList("obsContradictions", "", state.contradictions || []);
    renderTasks(record.tasks || []);
    const parking = state.parking_lot || [];
    const parkingJson = JSON.stringify(parking);
    fillList("obsParking", "obsParkingEmpty", parking);
    if (parkingSeen && parkingJson !== lastParkingJson) {
      const card = el("obsParkingCard");
      card.classList.add("highlight");
      window.setTimeout(function () {
        card.classList.remove("highlight");
      }, 2500);
    }
    parkingSeen = true;
    lastParkingJson = parkingJson;
    lastTaskJson = JSON.stringify(record.tasks || []);
    const stats = record.stats || {};
    el("obsCounters").textContent =
      "用户说了 " + String(stats.user_turns || 0) + " 句 · AI 开口 " +
      String(stats.ai_spoke || 0) + " 次 · 拉回 " + String(stats.pull_backs || 0) + " 次";
  }
  function renderSpend(data) {
    if (!data) {
      return;
    }
    const spent = Number(data.spent_usd || 0);
    const limit = Number(data.limit_usd || 0);
    el("obsSpend").textContent = "已花费 $" + spent.toFixed(4) + " / $" + limit.toFixed(2);
  }
  function stopPolling() {
    window.clearInterval(timer);
    timer = 0;
  }
  async function fetchJson(url) {
    const response = await fetch(url);
    const data = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok) {
      const message = (data && data.error && data.error.message) || "加载失败。";
      throw new Error(String(message));
    }
    return data;
  }
  async function pollOnce() {
    if (!sessionId) {
      return;
    }
    let record = null;
    try {
      record = await fetchJson("/api/sessions/" + sessionId);
    } catch (e) {
      showMessage("找不到这次思考。请确认链接里的 session 是否正确，或从开始页勾选“同时打开观察窗口”。");
      stopPolling();
      return;
    }
    let live = null;
    let spend = null;
    try {
      live = await fetchJson("/api/sessions/" + sessionId + "/live");
    } catch (e) {}
    try {
      spend = await fetchJson("/api/status");
    } catch (e) {}
    renderSession(record, live || {});
    renderSpend(spend);
    if (record.status === "finished") {
      const title = (record.result && record.result.title) || "成果";
      const banner = el("obsFinished");
      banner.textContent = "已结束 · " + String(title);
      banner.hidden = false;
      renderMic("offline");
      stopPolling();
    }
  }
  function init() {
    sessionId = sessionParam();
    if (!/^[0-9a-f]{32}$/.test(sessionId)) {
      showMessage("还没有指定要观察的思考。请从开始页勾选“同时打开观察窗口（录视频用）”，或使用带 session 参数的观察窗链接。");
      return;
    }
    pollOnce();
    timer = window.setInterval(pollOnce, 1000);
  }
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  return { init: init, pollOnce: pollOnce };
})();

> 总时长 3:00 ｜ 中文旁白 ｜ 一人出镜 + 两窗口录屏 ｜ 观众看观察窗，听真实对话

## 录制方式（先说清）

- **观众看到的画面**：观察窗（第二屏或第二个窗口，1280×720 录制）。它实时显示目标、麦克风状态、实时字幕、AI 上一次的决定、思路图、停车场、后台任务和计数。
- **观众听到的声音**：真实对话——出镜人对着黑屏手机/电脑出声思考，AI 只用语音回答。黑屏设备本身不入画（或只在开场露一下纯黑画面）。
- 黑屏端全程纯黑，什么都不显示；所有“AI 在干什么”的信息都靠观察窗讲给观众看。

---

## 录制前检查清单（setup checklist）

- [ ] 电脑和手机（如用手机模式）在同一 Wi-Fi；手机模式先跑 `python -m app.phone`，扫码打开并接受一次证书提示。
- [ ] 浏览器有中文语音（优先 Chrome / Edge，确认系统装有 zh-CN 语音）；开始页没有出现“没有中文语音”的提示。
- [ ] 黑屏端：允许麦克风权限，关掉系统通知和勿扰以外的弹窗，插耳机或确保外放能被录音设备收清。
- [ ] 开始页目标先打好草稿：`想清楚比赛 demo 的技术方案`。
- [ ] 勾选“同时打开观察窗口（录视频用）”；确认观察窗已打开、能看到目标和“在听”。
- [ ] 录屏软件只录观察窗窗口（1280×720），系统声音 + 麦克风双轨都开。
- [ ] 提前演练一遍计时：沉默提醒默认 60 秒才第一次出声，正式录制时“没说完的点”一节要预留真实等待（可后期加速，但不要剪掉 AI 开口的原因）。
- [ ] 预算状态正常（观察窗右下角花费未接近上限），网络稳定。
- [ ] 纸和笔放在手边（可选，展示“不看屏幕也能画”）。

---

## 分镜总览

| 时间 | 场景 | 观众看到（观察窗） | 观众听到（真实对话） |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0:00–0:20 | 痛点 | 观察窗待机 | 旁白 |
| 0:20–0:35 | 开始与黑屏 | 目标出现、状态“在听” | 入场语音 |
| 0:35–1:20 | 出声思考，AI 不说话 | 思路图一点点长出来 | 人连续说，AI 只偶尔轻响一声 tick |
| 1:20–1:45 | 跑题到火锅，被拉回 | 停车场高亮新增 | 拉回的一句话 |
| 1:45–2:15 | 帮我查一下 | 后台任务“进行中→完成” | 边查边说，答案一句话回来 |
| 2:15–2:30 | 没说完的点被提醒 | AI 决定变为“追问” | 沉默后的提醒 |
| 2:30–2:50 | 说结束，出成果页 | 显示成果标题，停止更新 | “好，我来整理” + 旁白念成果 |
| 2:50–3:00 | 收尾 | 成果页定格 | 旁白总结 |

---

## 0:00–0:20 痛点（20 秒）

**旁白：**

> “要想清楚一个方案，刚打开文档，就顺手刷了十分钟消息。干活的工具和分心的东西，是同一块屏幕。Blackout 不提醒你专注，它把屏幕拿走。”

**操作：** 镜头扫过开始页（录屏外画面或画中画一闪而过即可），停在观察窗。

---

## 0:20–0:35 开始与黑屏（15 秒）

**操作：** 在开始页输入目标“想清楚比赛 demo 的技术方案”，点击“开始”。黑屏端进入纯黑（可给 2 秒黑屏特写：只有一个很暗的角点）。

**观众听到（黑屏端入场语音，真实播报）：**

> “黑屏开始。我在听，你直接说就行。按空格暂停，想结束就说结束，或者按 Esc。”

**观众看到：** 观察窗上方目标出现，状态徽标是“在听”。

**旁白（轻声）：**

> “屏幕黑了。接下来他全程不看屏幕，我们看观察窗，听他想。”

---

## 0:35–1:20 出声思考，AI 保持安静（45 秒）

**出镜人原样说（照念，语速自然，中间可以有停顿）：**

> “我想讲三个点。第一，背景已经清楚了，就是评委只有五分钟，所以开头必须先给结论。第二是技术方案，第三是排期，第二和第三我还没想透。先说第一点，演示的时候先放最终效果，再倒回去讲怎么做的，这样评委不用等。决定了，开头先放效果。待办是今晚把演示视频录一版备用的。”

**观众听到：** AI 一句话都不说；每说完一段，只有一声很轻的 tick，说明“听到了，在记”。

**观众看到：**

- “正在说”字幕实时滚动；
- 思路图里出现三个点：第一点标“已展开”，“技术方案”和“排期”标“未展开”；
- “决定”里出现“开头先放效果”，“待办”里出现录备用视频；
- 计数在涨：用户说了 N 句，AI 开口还是 0 次。

**旁白：**

> “注意，AI 一直没说话。它只在记——点、决定、待办，都进图里了。它开口是有配额的，不打断人想。”

---

## 1:20–1:45 跑题：火锅（25 秒）

**出镜人原样说：**

> “对了，中午吃火锅吧，我想吃毛肚了。”

**观众听到（AI 立刻拉回，只一句）：**

> “这个我先记下了，我们回到比赛 demo 的技术方案。”

**观众看到：** 观察窗右下“停车场”短暂高亮，新增一条火锅；AI 决定显示“拉回主线”，计数里“拉回 1 次”。

**出镜人接着说（被带回来）：**

> “哦对，排期，周五之前要把演示跑通。”

**旁白：**

> “跑题没有被顺着聊。想法没丢，进了停车场，人被一句话带回来。”

---

## 1:45–2:15 帮我查一下（30 秒）

**出镜人原样说：**

> “帮我查一下 muse-spark-1.3 的价格是多少。”

**观众听到（AI 确认一句，然后继续听）：**

> “好，我去弄，你继续说。”

**出镜人不要停，继续说（照念）：**

> “那我接着说排期。周五跑通，周六留一天改问题。技术方案我最担心现场网络，所以演示要能离线跑。”

**观众看到：** “后台任务”出现一条“进行中”，思路图继续长；十几秒后任务变“完成”。

**观众听到（先一声两音提示音，AI 只念结论一句）：**

> “查到了：……（一句话结论，以现场真实播报为准）。”

**旁白：**

> “查东西的时候人不用停。结论只念一句，细节和来源都在成果页里，不打断思考。”

---

## 2:15–2:30 没说完的点被提醒（15 秒）

**出镜人原样说，然后停下不说话（真的静默，录制时保留等待，第一次提醒默认在沉默 60 秒后）：**

> “技术方案就先这样吧，呃……”

**观众听到（沉默后，AI 只问一句）：**

> “「技术方案」还没展开，还在想吗？”（以现场真实播报为准，点名的是未展开点。）

**观众看到：** AI 决定显示“追问”，并写明理由。

**出镜人补完：**

> “对，技术方案就是浏览器录音，后台只做记录和提醒，现场断网也能继续说，回来再整理。”

**旁白：**

> “它记得哪个点没说完。不是催你，是怕你自己忘了。”

---

## Theme and track

- Theme: Build for Your World

## One-liner

Blackout lets screen-tired thinkers do planning and brainstorming without looking at the screen — a black-screen voice partner that stays quiet by default, guards the thread of thought, and ends with a one-page result.

## The problem in my world

I do my best thinking away from the screen, but all my tools live inside it. The tool you work with and the thing that distracts you are the same screen. Existing focus tools remind you to concentrate; none of them remove the screen itself. I wanted a way to think a plan through eyes-free and still walk away with something written down.

## What it does

1. You type or speak a goal on the start page and press Start. The screen goes pure black (#000) with only a dim corner dot for status; a spoken line explains the controls, because you will not look again.
2. You think out loud, hands-free. The AI listens continuously and stays silent by default — a soft tick is all you hear for most turns. It tracks your main points against the goal, and speaks only when a point was left unfinished, you contradicted yourself, you drifted off the goal, you asked it something, or you have gone silent.
3. Drift is parked, not followed: the idea goes into a parking lot and one sentence pulls you back. “帮我查一下……” or “帮我写一段……” starts background work while you keep talking; a search reports back in one spoken sentence, a draft waits silently for the result page.
4. The microphone stays on while the AI speaks, so you can interrupt it mid-sentence; its own echo is recognised and discarded on the server. If hands-free streaming fails, it says so and falls back to push-to-talk recording.
5. Say “结束” (or press Esc, or hold a touch) and the screen returns with one page: title, goal, decisions, todos, parking lot, open questions, contradictions, unfinished points, background results with sources, and anything recognised from a photo of your paper sketch — plus a Copy as Markdown button.
6. An optional observer window (opened from the start page, designed for a second screen or for video) shows the goal, microphone state, live caption, the AI's last decision and reasoning, the growing thought map, the parking lot, background tasks, and spend — everything the black screen deliberately hides.

Unlike a general voice assistant that answers every sentence, Blackout owns the attention: its main behaviour is knowing when to say nothing, it remembers what you left unfinished, refuses to follow distractions, and delivers a page you can act on.

## How it works

- FastAPI backend (Python, thread-based) with a vanilla HTML/CSS/JS frontend. No framework, no external assets, no inline script or style; everything rendered from the server or the model uses `textContent`.
- Voice in: an AudioWorklet captures 24 kHz mono PCM in 80 ms frames over a WebSocket to the realtime endpoint of `muse-voice-transcribe-1.0` (endpointing mode, cumulative partials). A push-to-talk fallback records WAV and transcribes it with the same model via file upload.
- Voice out: the browser's `speechSynthesis` with a `zh-CN` voice (there is no text-to-speech model). Interruptions are detected by comparing recognised text against what the AI just spoke.
- The conductor: each turn sends the goal, current thinking state, and recent history to `muse-spark-1.3` with strict structured output. The model returns additions only — it can never rewrite or lose recorded state — plus a single decision (listen / follow up / pull back / continue / answer / summarise / background task). Server rules ration speech (a minimum gap, silent `listen` turns) on top of the model's judgement.
- Background work (`muse-spark-1.3` with `web_search`, and drafting) runs on a thread pool, never blocks a turn, and announces one spoken sentence on completion. Paper sketches are understood by `muse-spark-1.3` from a photo; only what is visible on the paper is recorded.
- The result page is one `muse-spark-1.3` summarising call that may merge and tighten but never invent; if it fails for any reason, the stored lists are rendered instead with a “degraded” notice. Sessions are one JSON file each, saved atomically after every turn, on the user's own machine.
- A phone launcher (`python -m app.phone`) serves the app over LAN HTTPS with a self-signed certificate and a random access token, because phones require HTTPS for the microphone. Spend is hard-capped locally by a budget ledger; the API key never reaches the browser or the logs, and speech and transcripts are never logged.

## Indie scope

Muse Spark, through the Meta Model API, generated all code in this repository, including the app, infrastructure, tests, and docs. The author provided the idea and tried the product. Claude Code drafted the prompts in `spec/` from the author's idea, ran the generation, reviewed and tested the output, and made the git commits; defects from review and use were written up in `spec/feedback_*.md`, the staged v2 build-out in `spec/stage_*.md`, and every fix was generated by Muse, including the infrastructure files which were regenerated from `spec/feedback_05.md` without seeing the earlier source.

import ipaddress
import os
import stat
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, List
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch

import pytest
from cryptography import x509
from cryptography.x509.oid import ExtensionOID

import app.phone as phone


def _cert_ips(cert_path: Path) -> List[str]:
    cert: Any = x509.load_pem_x509_certificate(cert_path.read_bytes())
    ext: Any = cert.extensions.get_extension_for_oid(ExtensionOID.SUBJECT_ALTERNATIVE_NAME).value
    return [str(value) for value in ext.get_values_for_type(x509.IPAddress)]


def test_certificate_has_ip_in_san_and_parses(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    cert_path, key_path = phone.ensure_certificate("192.168.1.23", tmp_path)
    assert cert_path.is_file() and key_path.is_file()
    # It parses as a real X.509 certificate.
    cert: Any = x509.load_pem_x509_certificate(cert_path.read_bytes())
    assert cert.subject.rfc4514_string()
    assert _cert_ips(cert_path) == ["192.168.1.23"]
    assert ipaddress.ip_address("192.168.1.23") in [
        ipaddress.ip_address(value) for value in _cert_ips(cert_path)
    ]
    assert phone.certificate_matches_ip(cert_path, "192.168.1.23") is True
    assert phone.certificate_matches_ip(cert_path, "192.168.1.24") is False


def test_existing_valid_certificate_is_reused(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    cert_path, key_path = phone.ensure_certificate("10.0.0.5", tmp_path)
    cert_bytes: bytes = cert_path.read_bytes()
    key_bytes: bytes = key_path.read_bytes()
    again_cert, again_key = phone.ensure_certificate("10.0.0.5", tmp_path)
    assert again_cert == cert_path and again_key == key_path
    assert again_cert.read_bytes() == cert_bytes
    assert again_key.read_bytes() == key_bytes


def test_regenerated_certificate_replaces_mismatched_one(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    cert_path, _key_path = phone.ensure_certificate("192.168.1.10", tmp_path)
    old_bytes: bytes = cert_path.read_bytes()
    assert _cert_ips(cert_path) == ["192.168.1.10"]
    new_cert, _new_key = phone.ensure_certificate("192.168.1.11", tmp_path)
    assert new_cert == cert_path
    assert new_cert.read_bytes() != old_bytes
    assert _cert_ips(new_cert) == ["192.168.1.11"]
    assert phone.certificate_matches_ip(new_cert, "192.168.1.10") is False
    assert phone.certificate_matches_ip(new_cert, "192.168.1.11") is True


def test_garbage_certificate_is_regenerated(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    cert_path, key_path = phone.ensure_certificate("172.16.0.9", tmp_path)
    cert_path.write_bytes(b"not a certificate")
    fixed_cert, _fixed_key = phone.ensure_certificate("172.16.0.9", tmp_path)
    assert _cert_ips(fixed_cert) == ["172.16.0.9"]
    assert key_path.is_file()


def test_private_key_has_restrictive_permissions(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    _cert_path, key_path = phone.ensure_certificate("192.168.1.30", tmp_path)
    if os.name == "nt":
        pytest.skip("POSIX permission bits are not applicable on Windows")
    mode: int = stat.S_IMODE(key_path.stat().st_mode)
    assert mode & 0o077 == 0


def test_token_has_sufficient_length_and_is_random() -> None:

    assert phone.generate_token() != token
    url: str = phone.build_url("192.168.1.2", token)

class _FakeSocket:
    """UDP socket stand-in: records calls, sends nothing."""

    def __init__(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        self.connected: Any = None
        self.sent: List[Any] = []

    def connect(self, address: Any) -> None:
        self.connected = address

    def getsockname(self) -> Any:
        return ("192.168.1.77", 54321)

    def send(self, data: Any) -> None:  # pragma: no cover - must never run

        raise AssertionError("get_lan_ip must not send packets")

    def sendto(self, data: Any, address: Any) -> None:  # pragma: no cover
        self.sent.append((data, address))
        raise AssertionError("get_lan_ip must not send packets")

    def close(self) -> None:
        return None

    assert fake.sent == []
